decisions.decision: poderia is licensed at L3 because it is the trophy, but only as the fixed request frame você poderia + infinitivo (3sg, você literal before any blank, cue poder (você)); it is not taught as productive condicional. The broader cortesia family (podia, dava para, seria possível, existe a possibilidade de) starts L5; plural meaning starts L6 only as a gente poderia. poderíamos is banned in the whole path so a gente and nós never form a blank pair.

deveria is licensed at L4 because it is the trophy, but only as the self-directed frame eu deveria + infinitivo inside a wh-question (qual etapa eu deveria fazer primeiro), eu literal before any blank, cue dever (eu). It is not advice yet. Advice to others and to the group (você deveria/devia, a gente deveria) starts L7, which is where the old L7-10 advice stage stays.

se/quando + futuro do subjuntivo first appears at L8, not L7. Reason: L7 is already the lesson where deveria becomes productive advice, and the thirds rule licenses one new function per lesson; L7 therefore states conditions lexically (a condição é + infinitivo, só dá para trocar com aviso). L8 introduces regular verbs plus tiver/puder; L9 adds estiver/for/houver; L10 recycles.

A regular futuro do subjuntivo form (precisar, usar, chegar, mudar, abrir) is identical to the infinitive and is never a blank, recall, speech or trophy token. Only tiver, puder, estiver, for, houver may be blanked, and only with the subject literal before the blank and the cue infinitive (subject), or the tag mesma pessoa with all four choices in one person.

Condicional forms allowed in P3 learner turns are exactly gostaria, poderia, deveria, seria (seria possível, seria melhor) and, from L9, 3sg ajudaria/resolveria with an explicit noun or infinitive subject (trocar de quarto já ajudaria). Everything else in condicional (faria, teria, daria, iria, poderíamos, deveríamos, preferiria) is banned in the path.

One politeness form per blank. gostaria, queria, poderia, podia, deveria, devia, preferia, dava para and seria possível are never offered against each other as cloze choices; distractors must be syntactically impossible in context (wrong person with a stated subject, wrong tense marker, noun in a verb slot).

Trophy preferência (noun) is realised as tenho preferência por + noun in turn 1; eu preferia (imperfeito de cortesia, 1sg, explicit eu) and prefiro remain licensed in the same lesson; preferiria stays banned path-wide as already recorded in mapFindings.

To avoid forcing an unlicensed form, L1-7 learner turns contain no future-time quando/se clause at all; use depois, na semana que vem, a partir de segunda, no outro horário. quando/se + presente do indicativo with future meaning is banned in learner scope for the whole path.
P2 keeps its recorded scope: no subjunctive of any kind, acho que não instead of não acho que + subjuntivo; nothing in this addendum licenses anything in P2.

replacementNativeGrammarScopeP3: L1 eu gostaria de + infinitivo (1sg, fixed request frame); L2 tenho preferência por + noun, eu preferia + noun/infinitivo (imperfeito de cortesia, 1sg with eu), prefiro; L3 você poderia + infinitivo as fixed request frame (3sg, você literal, cue poder (você)), not productive condicional; L4 eu deveria + infinitivo inside a wh-question (qual etapa eu deveria fazer primeiro), self-directed, not advice; L5 cortesia family broadens: podia + infinitivo, dava para + infinitivo, seria possível + infinitivo, existe/há a possibilidade de + infinitivo; L6 adds a gente poderia + infinitivo and tenho interesse em; L7 deveria/devia as productive advice with eu/você/a gente (explicit subject), conditions stated lexically (a condição é + infinitivo, só dá para … com + noun); L8 first se/quando + futuro do subjuntivo with regular verbs precisar, usar, chegar, mudar, abrir (form identical to the infinitive, never blanked) plus tiver/puder, main clause in presente or poderia; L9 adds estiver/for/houver and condicional 3sg ajudaria/resolveria/seria melhor with an explicit noun or infinitive subject; L10 recycles L1-L9 only. Path-wide bans: imperfeito do subjuntivo (se fosse, se pudesse), preferiria, poderíamos/deveríamos (plural meaning only via a gente + 3sg), presente do subjuntivo, any condicional outside gostaria, poderia, deveria, seria, ajudaria, resolveria, quando/se + presente with future meaning, and gostaria/queria/poderia/podia/deveria/devia/preferia as competing choices.

replacementSemanticStagingRule: Reviewer-caught staging: presente do subjuntivo first at P7 L6 (para que + whitelist) and nowhere else outside P7, P9, P10; se/quando + futuro do subjuntivo first at P3 L8 with regular verbs plus tiver/puder, estiver/for/houver from P3 L9, never earlier in P3 and never in P2, P4, P5, P6, P8; poderia first at P3 L3 only as você poderia + infinitivo, broader cortesia frames (podia, dava para, seria possível) from P3 L5, a gente poderia from P3 L6, poderíamos never; deveria first at P3 L4 only as eu deveria + infinitivo in a wh-question, advice to others (você/a gente deveria, devia) from P3 L7; condicional 3sg ajudaria/resolveria with explicit noun or infinitive subject from P3 L9; ia + infinitivo first at P1 L6; a regular futuro do subjuntivo form, identical to the infinitive, is never a blank, recall, speech or trophy token; irregular tiver/puder/estiver/for/houver may be blanked only with the subject literal before the blank and the cue infinitive (subject), or with the tag mesma pessoa and all four choices in one person; quando/se + presente with future meaning is a reviewer reject in every path.
authorInstructions: Keep every P3 trophy exactly as supplied and as a single word of learner turn 1 without apostrophe or hyphen; preferência enters as tenho preferência por, possibilidade as existe a possibilidade de, condição as qual é a condição para, acordo as fazer/propor um acordo, alternativa as existe alguma alternativa, prioridade as minha prioridade é.

Lock register per episode: service encounters (oficina, restaurante, cobrança, secretaria, imobiliária, voluntariado) default to formal with Sie and no te in learner turns; shared space (L8) and neighbours or group friends (L7, L9 if a host) may be neutral with du and a gente; o senhor/a senhora only in interlocutor turns, never blanked.

Every form blank in the follow-up uses cue infinitive (subject) and the subject literal must precede the blank in that follow-up: você before poderia/tiver/puder, eu before deveria/preferia, a gente before poderia/deveria; otherwise tag mesma pessoa with all four choices in one person.

Never place gostaria, queria, poderia, podia, deveria, devia, preferia, dava para or seria possível as alternatives to each other in one blank; distractors must be syntactically impossible (person clash with a stated subject, noun in a verb slot, wrong tense marker).

Never blank a regular futuro do subjuntivo (precisar, usar, chegar, mudar, abrir) and never use it as recall, speech or trophy token; blank only tiver/puder (L8) and estiver/for/houver (L9-10), at most one such blank per cloze.

In L1-7 write no future-time se/quando clause at all; use depois, na semana que vem, a partir de segunda, no outro horário; in L8-10 at most one se/quando clause per learner turn, main clause in presente or poderia.

Hold deveria to the eu deveria wh-question frame in L4-6 and open advice to others only at L7; hold poderia to the você poderia request frame in L3-4, add podia/dava para/seria possível at L5 and a gente poderia at L6.

Use only the condicional whitelist gostaria, poderia, deveria, seria plus 3sg ajudaria/resolveria from L9 with an explicit noun or infinitive subject; no preferiria, faria, teria, daria, iria, poderíamos, deveríamos anywhere in P3.

Gender safety: tenho interesse em, not estou interessado/a; recebi um convite, not fui convidado/a; agradeço, never obrigado/a in learner turns; interlocutor may keep a character-fixed obrigado/obrigada.

Brazilian lexicon and spelling only (ônibus, celular, banheiro, imóvel, caixa de som); desculpe never desculpa; all diacritics kept; de and en explanations everywhere, German du/Sie matching the locked register.

Do not write complete episodes or new trophies from this addendum; do not touch frozen P1 or the reviewed P2 scope; present each P3 episode for review against the exactP3StagingByLesson row for its lesson.
remainingLimitations: Validator pt-future-subjunctive-irregular is path-scoped (except paths 3, 7, 9, 10); a lesson-level guard for P3 L1-7 does not exist in schemaEdits, so premature tiver/puder/estiver/for/houver in P3 L1-7 is reviewer-caught until the owner adds a lesson-scoped rule.

The condicional whitelist (gostaria, poderia, deveria, seria, ajudaria, resolveria) and the poderíamos/deveríamos/preferiria bans are semantic reviewer items, not regexes; the owner may choose to promote them to structural rules.
The L7 lexical treatment of conditions makes L7 slightly lighter than L8; this is deliberate to keep one new function per lesson, but the author may feel pressure to use se there and must resist it.

The anchor wording fix (preferiria to eu preferia/tenho preferência) is proposed here as a wording correction consistent with the recorded mapFinding; it is not an owner approval and should be mirrored in the P3 map by whoever owns that file.
This addendum stages grammar only; vocabulary density, scene wording and story beats remain the current author's work and are reviewed per episode.
